Hx.bar_b_note: Dense grass and the giant ironwood trunk help, but flat midday light, a featureless horizon and lumpy canopies keep it short of Palworld/Valheim finish.

Vv.bar_b_note: B's furred naturalistic boar approaches the style bar but its gold leopard blotches and trainer-height scale fall short, while A's glazed clay piggy-bank boar is off-style entirely.

Oc.bar_b_note: The landmark is a small, flat-planed bank in the distance behind an empty grass foreground; B's mossy stratified outcrop helps but the frames lack the density and atmosphere of the bar.

Ol.bar_b_note: A murky brown forest floor with no purple storm sky, flat magenta ring/chevron telegraphs, an almost invisible player creature and a HUD covering a third of the frame sink it; B also loses the fight behind canopy for i12-i16.

To.bar_b_note: A's carved stone and mossy surrounds start to read as portals, but the hall is a flat plaster window-strip box with even light; B's neon-rimmed blank arches read as a placeholder.

Fp.bar_b_note: Same as Oc: the cameras frame mostly empty grass with a small flat-planed bank; B's stratified outcrop is the only element approaching the bar.

Hc.bar_b_note: B's aftermaths are site-specific (opened cage with freed villager, collapsed smoking tent, fallen banner), but blurry low-res ground textures and flat tiled walls keep the finish well under Palworld.

Zb.bar_b_note: A clean, appealing stylised elder with a readable face, warm eyes and an on-palette green/brown outfit sits comfortably beside Palworld's character finish.

top_changes.change: Recompose the Meadows production cameras (Hx, Oc, Fp) around the landmark: bring the bank face/ironwood into the midground, break the empty grass foreground with paths, rocks, flower clusters and props, and add a warm low-sun grade with blue distance haze and a layered horizon.

Fix the Stormwood fight read (Ol): replace flat magenta rings/chevrons with physical telegraphs (cracking ground, sparks, lightning), add the purple storm sky and rim light, keep the camera out of the canopy, scale up the player's creature and slim the HUD side/bottom panels.

Sculpt real stratified, mossy bank-face rock and leaf-card ironwood canopies to replace the flat grey planes and blobby canopy shells, and rebuild the clay-surfaced boar (Vv A) in the furred naturalistic style taller than the trainer.
